item.title: Gasnam: Spanish ports quadruples LNG bunkering volumes
item.description: According to data compiled by Gasnam, LNG supplies to ships in Spanish ports exceeded 8.1 TWh in 2025, more than quadrupling the volume recorded just two years prior.

item.title: LNG Industry Spotlight with MSA Safety
item.description: In this latest LNG Industry Spotlight Interview, Editor, Jessica Casey is joined by Felipe Krejci, FGFD BDM OGPC International at MSA Safety

item.title: Asyad Drydock and Svitzer to build first locally-manufactured tugboat for Oman LNG
item.description: Asyad Drydock, a subsidiary of Asyad Group, and Svitzer have signed a strategic agreement to build Oman’s first locally-manufactured tugboat for Oman LNG.

item.title: ENGIE welcomes LNG carrier
item.description: ENGIE has announced the latest addition to its fleet, the Amaryllis Knutsen, a 174 000 m3 LNG carrier.

item.title: XRG to increase stake in Rio Grande LNG
item.description: XRG will increase its overall participation in Rio Grande by acquiring additional 7.6% equity interests in Trains 4 and 5 of the Rio Grande LNG project from an acquisition vehicle of Global Infrastructure Partners.

item.title: Santos announces first Barossa LNG cargo
item.description: Santos has announced that the first LNG cargo from Barossa LNG has been loaded to the Kool Blizzard and will be delivered to the Sakai terminal in Japan.

item.title: Stolt-Nielsen in discussions to sell stake in Avenir LNG
item.description: Stolt-Nielsen Ltd has confirmed it is in discussions with a strategic buyer regarding the potential sale of up to 50% of its interest in Avenir LNG Ltd.

item.title: Nikkiso’s next-generation marine fuel cryogenic pump skids to support dual-fuel vessel conversions
item.description: Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases Group has signed an agreement with SunRui Marine Environment Engineering Co., Ltd to supply its next-generation cryogenic pump skids for dual-fuelled vessel applications.

item.title: Caribe LNG signs equity and supply agreements
item.description: Caribe LNG has announced the closing of a strategic minority equity investment by Six One Commodities and LNG supply agreements, under which 61C will supply LNG for the initial phase of the Caribe LNG project in Colombia.

item.title: MOL and GAIL sign charter contract for LNG carrier
item.description: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd and GAIL (India) Ltd have entered into a long-term charter agreement for an LNG carrier named GAIL BHUWAN.
